item.title: Israel-Iran Conflict: Iran War Live Updates: Hegseth Vows to Reopen Key Strait as U.S. Measures Fail to Calm Oil Market
item.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said that the U.S. military would stop Iran from choking off the Strait of Hormuz but did not say how. Oil prices remained high even after the Trump administration eased restrictions on Russian shipments.

item.title: How the War in Iran Could Help China and Change Asia
item.summary: American officials have said for years that they would prioritize the Indo-Pacific. Now they’re moving warships, missiles and air defenses out for a war in the Middle East.

item.title: A Visit to a Temple at the Heart of the Thailand-Cambodia Conflict
item.summary: A rare visit to a Khmer temple on Thailand and Cambodia’s border showed how deadly clashes between the two countries have scarred a heritage site.

item.title: Iran’s Frantic Attempt to Save Its Ships Before Torpedo Attack
item.summary: The Iranian Navy sought refuge in Sri Lanka and India. While India obliged, Sri Lanka stalled over fears it would threaten its neutrality.

item.title: Ground Down by War, Hezbollah’s Loyal Base Shows Cracks
item.summary: “We just want to be back in our homes,” said a Lebanese man who, like many others in the latest round of fighting, has to flee.

item.title: Hegseth says an officer has been appointed to investigate deadly strike on Iranian school.
U.S. Tech Giants Flocked to the Persian Gulf. Now They Are Targets.
item.summary: Amazon, Google and others struck deals in the Persian Gulf to foot the bill for A.I. development. Iran has now threatened attacks against the companies’ infrastructure in the region.

item.title: U.S. Sanctions Pause Adds Political Win to Russia’s Economic Gain From Iran War
item.summary: Kremlin officials said the American move, which Europe opposes, showed that Moscow could not be dislodged from the center of global energy markets.

item.title: Hegseth Vows Lethal Day in Iran as Air War Intensifies
item.summary: At a news conference, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave no indication of how long it would take before the Navy could escort civilian cargo ships through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Drone Strike Has Cyprus, and Europe, on Edge
item.summary: Allies have rushed to defend the Mediterranean nation, where the drone hit a British base. Some Cypriots wonder why the bases are still there.
